purkinje_cell_cerebellum.label: Purkinje cell
purkinje_cell_cerebellum.note: CL:0000121 label is 'Purkinje cell' (not cerebellar-specific in name but the definition explicitly describes the cerebellar Purkinje cell). Exact match to proposed type. OLS4 returned no PMID/DOI xrefs in term detail.

basket_cell_cerebellum.label: cerebellar basket cell
basket_cell_cerebellum.note: Direct name match. Definition confirms GABAergic MLI in molecular layer forming pericellular baskets and pinceau around Purkinje cells. OLS4 returned no PMID/DOI xrefs in term detail.

stellate_cell_cerebellum.label: cerebellar stellate cell
stellate_cell_cerebellum.note: Direct name match. Definition confirms GABAergic interneuron in molecular layer providing feed-forward inhibition of Purkinje cells. OLS4 returned no PMID/DOI xrefs in term detail.

candelabrum_cell_cerebellum.label: candelabrum cell
candelabrum_cell_cerebellum.note: Direct name match. CL definition matches proposed type exactly: GABAergic interneuron in Purkinje layer with small soma, pially-extending dendrites, beaded local axons in ML; excited by mossy fibers/granule cells, inhibited by Purkinje cells, inhibits MLIs. OLS4 returned no PMID/DOI xrefs in term detail.

mli_transcriptomic_classes_cerebellum.label: molecular layer interneuron
mli_transcriptomic_classes_cerebellum.note: No CL term exists for the MLI1/MLI2 transcriptomic class distinction (Kozareva et al. 2020 / Lowenstein et al. 2022 class I/class II). CL:4042035 'molecular layer interneuron' is the closest parent term — a BROAD match covering the category but not capturing the transcriptomically-defined subtype split. This node is a potential CL contribution for two new subtypes (MLI1/class I and MLI2/class II). OLS4 returned no PMID/DOI xrefs in term detail.
